compatibility_policy: Additive changes within v1; breaking changes require a new major schema file and migration note.

tools.name: create_document
tools.title: Create Word document
tools.description: Use this when a new DOCX is needed. Creates an isolated draft; it does not overwrite any user file. Page settings are bounded and the result must be saved/exported explicitly.

tools.name: create_from_template
tools.title: Create from Word template
tools.description: Use this when a DOCX or DOTX template must be preserved. Downloads only the authorized file reference, rejects macros and unsafe packages, copies it into an isolated session, and creates a new DOCX draft.

tools.name: create_from_markdown
tools.title: Create from Markdown
tools.description: Use this when Markdown must become a new DOCX. Accepts raw Markdown or an authorized .md file, preserves a supplied template only when separately requested, and never converts an existing DOCX through Markdown.

tools.name: open_document
tools.title: Open Word document
tools.description: Use this when an uploaded DOCX must be inspected or edited. Reads an authorized ChatGPT file reference, rejects DOCM/DOTM, ZIP bombs, XXE and unsafe relationships, then opens an isolated round-trip draft.

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.title: Inspect Word document
tools.description: Use this for a read-only overview of package parts, structure, styles, sections, tables and native equations. It does not save or mutate the draft.

tools.name: save_document
tools.title: Save Word document
tools.description: Use this to create a new validated DOCX version. It never overwrites the uploaded original. Saving may apply documented structural repairs and returns a temporary download link.

tools.name: close_document
tools.title: Close Word document
tools.description: Use this to discard the in-memory draft and delete its extracted temporary files. Previously exported versions remain available until their artifact expiry.

tools.name: get_outline
tools.title: Get document outline
tools.description: Use this to read heading levels, text and stable paragraph IDs without changing the draft.

tools.name: get_sections
tools.title: Get document sections
tools.description: Use this to inspect page sizes, margins, orientation, columns and section breaks without changing the draft.

tools.name: get_paragraph
tools.title: Get paragraph
tools.description: Use this to read one paragraph by its w14:paraId. It returns text and style but does not flatten the whole document.

tools.name: insert_paragraph
tools.title: Insert paragraph
tools.description: Use this to insert one styled paragraph after a known paragraph ID. It mutates only document.xml and preserves unrelated parts.

tools.name: replace_paragraph
tools.title: Replace paragraph
tools.description: Use this to replace the text and/or style of one paragraph. This is a direct edit, not a document rebuild; use insert_tracked_change when review markup is required.

tools.name: delete_paragraph
tools.title: Delete paragraph
tools.description: Use this to remove exactly one paragraph from the current draft. The uploaded original is untouched, but the draft mutation is destructive until rejected by reopening or restoring a prior export.

tools.name: move_block
tools.title: Move document block
tools.description: Use this to move one paragraph or top-level table before or after another block. References use p:<paraId> or table:<zero-based-index>.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.title: List Word styles
tools.description: Use this to inspect paragraph and character styles before applying formatting. It is read-only.

tools.name: create_style
tools.title: Create Word style
tools.description: Use this to add one named paragraph or character style to styles.xml. Prefer this over direct formatting for reusable formatting.

tools.name: update_style
tools.title: Update Word style
tools.description: Use this to change inheritance or next-style metadata of one existing named style. It does not replace unrelated style definitions.

tools.name: apply_style
tools.title: Apply Word style
tools.description: Use this to apply an existing style to explicit paragraph IDs. It avoids replacing template styles with direct formatting.

tools.name: inspect_direct_formatting
tools.title: Inspect direct formatting
tools.description: Use this to find run-level direct formatting that may override styles. It does not alter the document.

tools.name: normalize_formatting
tools.title: Normalize direct formatting
tools.description: Use this to remove supported direct run properties from selected paragraphs so style inheritance can take effect. It preserves fields, text and paragraph structure.

tools.name: format_paragraph
tools.title: Format one Word paragraph
tools.description: Set paragraph alignment, spacing, indentation, tab stops and pagination flags without changing its text or style assignment.

tools.name: format_run
tools.title: Format one Word run
tools.description: Set direct font, size, color, highlight, emphasis, underline, strike or sub/superscript on one run identified by paragraph and run index.

tools.name: manage_lists
tools.title: Manage Word lists
tools.description: Inspect, apply, create, restart, promote, demote or suppress native single- and multilevel Word numbering definitions.

tools.name: insert_caption
tools.title: Insert Word caption
tools.description: Insert a native Caption-styled paragraph with sequence text after a figure or table anchor.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.title: List Word tables
tools.description: Use this for a compact read-only inventory of tables and cell content.

tools.name: get_table
tools.title: Get Word table
tools.description: Use this to read one table by zero-based index, including its cells and properties.

tools.name: insert_table
tools.title: Insert Word table
tools.description: Use this to insert one native Word table after a paragraph. Row and column counts are bounded to prevent pathological documents.

tools.name: modify_table
tools.title: Modify Word table
tools.description: Use this for one bounded table operation: add_row, delete_row, delete_table, sort, apply_style or duplicate_row. It does not rebuild the document.

tools.name: merge_cells
tools.title: Merge table cells
tools.description: Use this to merge a rectangular range of cells in one table. Coordinates are zero-based and the operation changes table grid semantics.

tools.name: split_cells
tools.title: Split merged table cell
tools.description: Use this to remove supported horizontal/vertical merge properties from one cell. Complex irregular merges are reported rather than silently rebuilt.

tools.name: set_cell_properties
tools.title: Set table cell properties
tools.description: Use this to change one cell's width, vertical alignment or shading, optionally its row height. Only provided properties are touched.

tools.name: insert_equation
tools.title: Insert native Word equation
tools.description: Use this to insert LaTeX, UnicodeMath, Presentation MathML, OMML or structured AST as native Office Math. Inline output is m:oMath; display output is m:oMathPara. No rasterization or text fallback occurs.

tools.name: replace_equation
tools.title: Replace native Word equation
tools.description: Use this to replace exactly one equation by equation_id while retaining native OMML and the surrounding document structure.

tools.name: list_equations
tools.title: List native Word equations
tools.description: Use this for a read-only inventory of m:oMath elements with stable per-draft IDs, display/inline status and canonical AST.

tools.name: get_equation
tools.title: Get native Word equation
tools.description: Use this to read one equation as OMML plus best-effort LaTeX, UnicodeMath, MathML and canonical AST.

tools.name: convert_equation
tools.title: Convert equation format
tools.description: Use this for a stateless semantic conversion among LaTeX, UnicodeMath, Presentation MathML, OMML and the WordToolkit AST. Unsupported syntax fails explicitly; no image or plain-text fallback is emitted.

tools.name: validate_equations
tools.title: Validate native Word equations
tools.description: Use this to parse every m:oMath in the current draft and report structural failures without modifying the document.

tools.name: number_equations
tools.title: Number display equations
tools.description: Use this to add automatic SEQ Equation fields and bookmarks after display equations. Existing source equations remain native OMML; fields are update-on-open in Word.

tools.name: add_equation_reference
tools.title: Add equation reference
tools.description: Use this to append a native REF field pointing to a numbered equation bookmark. Word updates the cached field value when fields are refreshed.

tools.name: manage_headers_footers
tools.title: Manage headers and footers
tools.description: Read, create, replace or remove a default/first/even header or footer story. PAGE and NUMPAGES placeholders use {{PAGE}} and {{NUMPAGES}} native fields.

tools.name: manage_footnotes_endnotes
tools.title: Manage footnotes and endnotes
tools.description: List, add, update, delete or structurally validate native Word footnotes/endnotes. Note references and definition parts are kept linked.

tools.name: manage_comments
tools.title: Manage Word comments
tools.description: List comment threads or add, reply, update, resolve and delete native Word comments and comment-extension metadata.

tools.name: manage_bookmarks
tools.title: Manage bookmarks
tools.description: List, add, read or remove Word bookmarks. Bookmark names are constrained to Word-compatible identifiers.

tools.name: manage_cross_references
tools.title: Manage cross references
tools.description: List hyperlinks or add an internal cross-reference between two paragraph IDs using a bookmark-backed Word hyperlink.

tools.name: manage_fields
tools.title: Manage Word fields
tools.description: List, add, delete or mark fields for update. Field codes are bounded; common values include TOC, PAGE, NUMPAGES and REF bookmark.

tools.name: insert_image
tools.title: Insert embedded image
tools.description: Download an authorized PNG/JPEG/GIF/TIFF image, verify its image type, then embed it through DrawingML. No external image relationship is created.

tools.name: manage_sections
tools.title: Manage Word sections
tools.description: Inspect or change page/section properties including breaks, size, margins, orientation, columns and first/odd-even headers.

tools.name: enable_track_changes
tools.title: Enable tracked changes
tools.description: Enable or disable Word's w:trackRevisions setting. This does not retroactively wrap existing content.

tools.name: list_tracked_changes
tools.title: List tracked changes
tools.description: Read pending w:ins and w:del revisions with author, date, paragraph and text; no mutation occurs.

tools.name: insert_tracked_change
tools.title: Insert tracked change
tools.description: Insert, delete or replace text using native Word revision elements. Context may be supplied to disambiguate a match.

tools.name: accept_changes
tools.title: Accept tracked changes
tools.description: Accept one change by ID or all pending revisions. This is destructive within the draft; the uploaded original remains untouched.

tools.name: reject_changes
tools.title: Reject tracked changes
tools.description: Reject one change by ID or all pending revisions. This is destructive within the draft; the uploaded original remains untouched.

tools.name: compare_documents
tools.title: Compare two Word documents
tools.description: Compare two authorized DOCX files and return a third DOCX containing native insertion/deletion revision markup. The inputs are never overwritten.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_package
tools.title: Inspect a Word OOXML package
tools.description: Read a local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM without opening Word. Return a bounded OPC graph summary, content-type and relationship diagnostics, a stable package fingerprint, and optional part metadata. External relationship targets are never fetched and remain redacted.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local Word package.

include_details.description: Include bounded part and relationship metadata; raw content is never returned.

max_items.description: Maximum diagnostics, parts, and relationships returned per collection.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_semantics
tools.title: Inspect Word semantic structure
tools.description: Project a saved Word OOXML package into bounded, source-linked semantic nodes without opening Word. Traverses the main document plus related headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes, comments and glossary stories, and returns stable node IDs, part counts, structure counts, and a compact outline.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

text_preview_chars.description: Maximum text characters returned per outline node; use zero to omit previews.

include_source_paths.description: Include source part URIs and XML paths for debugging or precise follow-up.

tools.name: query_ooxml_semantics
tools.title: Query Word semantic nodes
tools.description: Query all projected text-bearing stories in a saved Word OOXML package by semantic node kind, bounded text predicate, exact semantic properties, source part, or subtree. Returns paged stable node IDs and compact previews without opening Word or returning raw XML.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

kinds.description: Optional semantic node kinds. Omit to search every kind.

text.description: Optional text predicate. Matching streams across run/text boundaries when text_scope is subtree.

text_scope.description: Use subtree to match a paragraph, table, equation, or other container across its descendant text nodes.

property_equals.description: Optional exact semantic property predicates, for example {"style_id":"Definition"}.

within_node_id.description: Optional semantic node whose subtree bounds the query.

source_part_uri.description: Optional exact OPC part URI filter.

include_source.description: Include source part, normalized XML path, and lexical element ordinal.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_sections
tools.title: Inspect Word sections and story bindings
tools.description: Resolve Word section boundaries, page properties, and effective default, first-page, and even-page header/footer bindings. Reports explicit, inherited, blank, and suppressed variants without opening Word or returning document text.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

binding_detail.description: Use effective for displayed targets, full for source relationship provenance, or none for section metadata only.

include_properties.description: Include bounded page size, margins, columns, numbering, orientation, and section-break properties.

include_story_part_uris.description: Include bounded referenced and unbound header/footer part URI inventories.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_styles
tools.title: Inspect Word styles and inheritance
tools.description: Inspect the typed styles.xml graph, document defaults, latent styles, and bounded basedOn inheritance diagnostics without opening Word. Metadata is returned by default; declared formatting and source provenance are opt-in to minimize AI tokens.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

detail.description: Use declared for normalized property blocks or inheritance for those blocks plus base-first style chains and source element ordinals.

include_latent_styles.description: Include latent-style defaults and at most 40 named exceptions.

include_issues.description: Include at most 40 bounded inheritance, linked-style, next-style, and default-style diagnostics.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_numbering
tools.title: Inspect and resolve Word numbering
tools.description: Inspect the typed numbering.xml graph or resolve one effective list level through num, abstractNum, numbering-style links, level overrides, and start overrides without opening Word. Compact instance metadata is returned by default; levels, declared formatting, and source ordinals are opt-in.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Inventory numbering instances or abstract definitions, or resolve one concrete number_id and level_index.

number_id.description: Optional exact instance filter; required and positive for resolved_level.

detail.description: Use levels for level/override metadata or declared to add normalized paragraph/run properties and unmodeled element names.

include_issues.description: Include at most 40 bounded missing-reference, linkage, range, and corruption diagnostics.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_theme
tools.title: Inspect the Word document theme
tools.description: Inspect the typed Office theme graph behind Word theme colors, major/minor fonts, and format-style inventories without opening Word. Compact resolved metadata is returned by default; raw declarations, transforms, unknown markup, and source ordinals are opt-in to minimize AI tokens.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Return color slots, primary and supplemental theme fonts, or the format-scheme inventory.

detail.description: Use declared to include bounded raw source values, transforms, supplemental metadata, and unknown markup.

include_issues.description: Include at most 40 bounded missing-slot, environment-dependent, and unresolved-transform diagnostics.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_settings
tools.title: Inspect Word document settings
tools.description: Inspect a typed settings.xml graph without opening Word: Boolean document behavior, theme font languages, compatibility mode, protection metadata, legacy document variables, mail merge, view settings, and a root inventory. Secret-bearing variable values, connection strings, queries, and relationship targets are redacted unless explicitly requested; pagination keeps AI token use bounded.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Return compact Boolean settings, compatibility declarations, privacy-redacted document variables, mail-merge metadata, or the root-element inventory.

include_sensitive.description: Opt in to bounded document-variable names and values, mail-merge queries and connection strings, and template/data-source targets. Protection hashes and salts are never returned.

include_issues.description: Include at most 40 bounded settings diagnostics.

include_source.description: Include settings part URI and source XML element ordinals.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_fonts
tools.title: Inspect the Word font table
tools.description: Inspect the typed fontTable.xml graph and embedded-font relationships without opening Word. Distinguishes font declarations from package-backed embedded faces, checks Word-readable content types and font keys, never returns font bytes, and uses opt-in detail, hashes, source data, filtering, and pagination to minimize AI tokens.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Return font declarations, embedded faces, or unreferenced embedded-font relationship targets.

font_name.description: Optional exact case-insensitive font-name filter for fonts and embedded_faces views.

detail.description: Use declared to include PANOSE/signature declarations, font keys, and bounded unknown markup.

include_hashes.description: Include SHA-256 hashes for embedded font parts; font bytes are never returned.

include_issues.description: Include at most 40 bounded duplicate-name, relationship, content-type, font-key, and orphan diagnostics.

include_source.description: Include part URIs and source XML element ordinals.

tools.name: resolve_ooxml_formatting
tools.title: Resolve modeled Word formatting
tools.description: Resolve bounded paragraph and run properties for one semantic paragraph or run through document defaults, base-first paragraph styles, effective numbering levels, character styles, direct formatting, document settings, the theme, and the font table. Returns language/script-aware concrete theme fonts, declared/embedded font metadata, and RGB colors with provenance plus explicit omissions when conditional table styles, an unmappable locale, Office color quantization, revisions, application defaults, unmodeled elements, or a documented Word compatibility edge can still affect the final appearance.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

node_id.description: Paragraph or run node ID returned by semantic inspect/query for the same package fingerprint.

property_names.description: Optional exact property-name allowlist to minimize output.

max_properties.description: Maximum returned properties in each paragraph/run group.

include_provenance.description: Include each hierarchy contribution and its resulting value.

include_source.description: Include selected-node and contribution part URIs and source element ordinals.

include_unmodeled.description: Include bounded source-qualified names of property elements outside this resolver slice.

tools.name: plan_ooxml_text_edits
tools.title: Plan lossless Word text edits
tools.description: Resolve a bounded batch of semantic Word or OfficeMath text-node replacements against an exact saved-package fingerprint. Returns a compact deterministic plan and predicted result fingerprint without writing the file or retaining server-side document content.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

expected_package_fingerprint.description: Exact fingerprint returned by inspect/query. Planning fails if the package changed.

include_details.description: Include bounded per-operation and changed-part impact metadata; never returns document text.

tools.name: apply_ooxml_text_edits
tools.title: Apply planned lossless Word text edits
tools.description: Rebuild and atomically apply an already reviewed semantic text-edit plan to a saved Word OOXML package. Requires the original package fingerprint and deterministic plan ID, validates the candidate, rejects signed packages, and can retain a sibling recovery backup.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the existing local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file modified in place.

expected_plan_id.description: Plan ID returned by plan_ooxml_text_edits for the exact same commands.

keep_backup.description: Retain the atomic writer's sibling recovery backup after success.

tools.name: validate_ooxml
tools.title: Validate OOXML package
tools.description: Run bounded ZIP/OPC, XML, relationship, note, paraId and native OMML validation on a snapshot without committing a version.

tools.name: audit_document
tools.title: Audit Word document
tools.description: Audit document structure and external relationship inventory. No external target is fetched and no content is logged.

tools.name: detect_corruption
tools.title: Detect document corruption
tools.description: Run integrity validation and return a corruption verdict with explicit issue codes; it does not modify the draft.

tools.name: repair_document
tools.title: Repair Word document
tools.description: Apply the engine's conservative pre-save repairs, validate the package, and return a new DOCX artifact. Unknown untouched parts remain round-trip protected.

tools.name: check_accessibility
tools.title: Check document accessibility
tools.description: Check image alternative text, heading order, table headers and language metadata using OOXML heuristics.

tools.name: check_layout_risks
tools.title: Check layout risks
tools.description: Check static OOXML layout risks such as over-wide tables and headings lacking keep-with-next. Rendering checks are separate.

tools.name: detect_orphaned_relationships
tools.title: Detect orphaned relationships
tools.description: Report missing internal relationship targets and unreferenced OPC parts without deleting them.

tools.name: render_document
tools.title: Render Word document
tools.description: Save, validate and render the current draft to PDF with isolated LibreOffice headless, then run page-level visual heuristics. Word and LibreOffice are not pixel-identical.

tools.name: render_pages
tools.title: Render Word pages
tools.description: Save and render the draft to PDF and bounded PNG page previews using LibreOffice and Poppler. Returns MCP resource links instead of internal working paths.

tools.name: convert_to_pdf
tools.title: Convert Word document to PDF
tools.description: Validate the draft, convert it with LibreOffice headless, render pages for visual QA, and return the PDF. Pagination may differ from Microsoft Word.

tools.name: export_document
tools.title: Export Word document
tools.description: Export the current draft as a new validated DOCX or as best-effort Markdown. DOCX export preserves untouched OPC parts; Markdown is intentionally lossy.

tools.name: generate_preview
tools.title: Generate document preview
tools.description: Generate a PDF plus the first preview pages and visual-audit findings for mobile review. The preview is LibreOffice-based, not a pixel guarantee for Word.

tools.name: list_live_word_documents
tools.title: List open Microsoft Word documents
tools.description: List documents in the already-running Microsoft Word application. This local Windows-only tool never launches Word and never opens a file copy.

tools.name: create_live_word_document
tools.title: Create a new document in running Microsoft Word
tools.description: Create and connect to a new blank document inside the already-running Microsoft Word application. Optionally save it to one explicit new .docx path; existing files are never overwritten.

tools.name: connect_live_word_document
tools.title: Connect to an open Microsoft Word document
tools.description: Connect WordToolkit to exactly one document that is already open in Microsoft Word. The returned live_document_id targets the real Word document rather than an isolated DOCX draft.

tools.name: inspect_live_word_document
tools.title: Inspect connected Word Live document
tools.description: Read live Microsoft Word metadata and counts for a connected document without exporting or rebuilding it.

tools.name: map_live_word_structures
tools.title: Map structures in connected Microsoft Word document
tools.description: Inventory Word stories and bounded collection counts for sections, styles, tables, equations, fields, bookmarks, links, comments, revisions, content controls, shapes, notes, lists and generated tables without returning document content.

tools.name: inspect_live_word_structure_items
tools.title: Inspect native items in one Word structure collection
tools.description: Read a bounded page of semantic metadata from one native Word collection through one COM attachment. Supports paragraphs, sections, styles, tables, equations, fields, forms, bookmarks, links, comments, revisions, content controls, shapes, notes, lists, subdocuments, variables and generated tables. External addresses and field codes are never returned; optional text previews are bounded and never stored by adaptive learning.

tools.name: inspect_live_word_equation_learning
tools.title: Inspect local Word equation learning
tools.description: Read privacy-preserving aggregate outcomes learned from native Word equation classes. No formula text, document text, paths or owner identifiers are stored or returned.

tools.name: inspect_live_word_structure_learning
tools.title: Inspect local Word structure learning
tools.description: Read privacy-preserving aggregate evidence used to schedule adaptive native type scans. It stores only fixed collection names, native enum values, scan outcomes and timing—never document content, counts, paths, handles or identifiers.

tools.name: inspect_live_word_object_model_types
tools.title: Browse installed Microsoft Word object-model types
tools.description: Build or query a bounded local catalog of the actual Word COM type library installed on this PC. Returns paged API type metadata only—never document content, document counts, paths, handles, owner identifiers, help text or help-file paths. The first scan attaches read-only to already-running Word; cached queries do not attach again. Set refresh=true after an Office update.

tools.name: inspect_live_word_object_model_members
tools.title: Browse members of one installed Microsoft Word object-model type
tools.description: Return a bounded page of methods, properties, parameters, variables or enum values for one exact type from the cached installed Word COM catalog. No Word document content or local help paths are read, stored or returned.

tools.name: inspect_live_word_member_capabilities
tools.title: Browse individual virtual tools for installed Microsoft Word members
tools.description: Return a bounded page from the derived registry. Every installed Word COM catalog member has one stable capability profile, one unique virtual-tool name, and validated JSON input/output schemas. Query by type, member name, capability ID, or virtual-tool name. Constants, reads, document-scoped edits, events, lifecycle actions and blocked external effects remain distinct, and arbitrary COM paths are never exposed.

tools.name: preflight_live_word_member_operations
tools.title: Preflight catalog-backed Microsoft Word member operations
tools.description: Validate up to 50 operations against their per-member virtual-tool contracts: stable capability IDs, typed targets, result and enum-constant references, optional omissions, argument positions, COM parameter types and safety policy before any live Word mutation.

tools.name: execute_live_word_member_operations
tools.title: Execute catalog-backed operations in an open Microsoft Word document
tools.description: Execute up to 50 preflighted per-member virtual tools by stable capability ID. Targets are restricted to the connected document, its current selection or content, and typed results of earlier operations. A mutating batch requires expected_version and runs in one Word Undo record with rollback on failure. Indexed setters remain non-executable until their exact Word Undo behavior is proven.

tools.name: get_live_word_selection
tools.title: Read Word Live selection
tools.description: Read the current cursor or selection range and a selection_token for a subsequent cursor or selection mutation. Selected text is bounded to 10,000 characters.

tools.name: find_live_word_text
tools.title: Find text in the connected Microsoft Word document
tools.description: Run bounded native Word Find against the connected document and return exact ranges, short context, and a content-bound range_token for each match. Supports Word wildcards without returning or rebuilding the full document.

tools.name: replace_live_word_text
tools.title: Replace text transactionally in the connected Microsoft Word document
tools.description: Find and replace up to 5,000 native Word matches through one COM attachment and one custom Undo record. The complete match set is bounded before mutation, optimistic live_version is required, Track Changes state is restored, and partial failure rolls back.

tools.name: inspect_live_word_review
tools.title: Inspect comments or tracked revisions in Microsoft Word
tools.description: Read one bounded page of live comments or revisions and issue a content-bound review_token for every item. Later mutations require the matching token and reject stale raw indexes.

tools.name: manage_live_word_review
tools.title: Manage comments and tracked revisions in Microsoft Word
tools.description: Add a comment to a fresh selection, reply to, resolve, or delete a token-verified comment, accept or reject one token-verified revision, or set Track Changes. Undoable actions use one custom record with rollback; non-undoable Word properties use verified manual rollback.

tools.name: diagnose_live_word_layout
tools.title: Diagnose live Microsoft Word layout
tools.description: Run a bounded single-pass scan for keep-with-next chains, long headings, body page breaks, oversized keep-together paragraphs, disabled widow control, empty-paragraph runs, manual page breaks and heading-style overuse. Returns ranges and metadata, never document text.

tools.name: inspect_live_word_undo
tools.title: Inspect guarded Microsoft Word Undo
tools.description: Read a bounded Word Undo list and issue an undo_token only when the current top entry begins with WordToolkit:. Undocumented Word history access is treated as optional and failure closes the gate.

tools.name: undo_live_word_operation
tools.title: Undo exactly one verified WordToolkit operation
tools.description: Undo only the current top Word entry, only when it is labeled WordToolkit: and still matches a fresh undo_token plus expected live_version. It never accepts a raw count and never crosses a manual user edit.

tools.name: insert_live_word_text
tools.title: Insert text directly in open Microsoft Word
tools.description: Insert text into the real open Word document at the verified selection, cursor, or document end. It can create a styled paragraph and the change appears immediately in Word.

tools.name: format_live_word_selection
tools.title: Format the current selection directly in Microsoft Word
tools.description: Apply a Word style plus bounded font and paragraph formatting to the exact non-empty live selection verified by a fresh selection token. The operation uses one COM attachment, one Undo record and no text round-trip.

tools.name: insert_live_word_table
tools.title: Insert a native table directly in Microsoft Word
tools.description: Create a rectangular native Word table from up to 5,000 cells in one COM attachment. Text is inserted once as a bounded tab/paragraph payload and converted with Range.ConvertToTable, avoiding per-cell COM writes.

tools.name: preflight_live_word_table_formulas
tools.title: Preflight native Word table formulas
tools.description: Validate up to 200 typed table-cell calculations without attaching to Word. Supports SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MAX, MIN and PRODUCT over positional directions or bounded A1-style ranges generated from row and column coordinates; raw formulas and field codes are never accepted.

tools.name: insert_live_word_table_formulas
tools.title: Insert native formulas into an existing Word table
tools.description: Insert and calculate up to 200 typed native formula fields in cells of one existing rectangular Word table through one COM attachment and one Undo transaction. Destination cells must be empty unless replacement is explicitly enabled; native field types, result ranges and final counts are verified. Formula fields calculate on insertion; force_update requests an additional explicit recalculation.

tools.name: update_live_word_table_fields
tools.title: Update all native fields in one existing Word table
tools.description: Recalculate up to 5,000 existing native fields—including table formulas—in one Word Fields.Update call, one COM attachment and one Undo transaction. Field types and counts are verified before and after; field codes, results and document content are never returned.

tools.name: insert_live_word_list
tools.title: Insert a native list directly in Microsoft Word
tools.description: Create up to 1,000 native bulleted or numbered Word paragraphs in one COM attachment. The complete text is inserted once, then one bounded Range.ListFormat operation applies native numbering without per-item COM writes.

tools.name: preflight_live_word_bookmarks
tools.title: Preflight native Word bookmarks
tools.description: Validate up to 200 named Word bookmark ranges without attaching to Word. Names are bounded and case-insensitively unique; document text is not returned.

tools.name: insert_live_word_bookmarks
tools.title: Insert native bookmarks directly in Microsoft Word
tools.description: Insert up to 200 named native Word bookmarks through one COM attachment, one text payload and one Undo transaction. Existing-name collisions and any native range mismatch fail before the live version advances.

tools.name: preflight_live_word_fields
tools.title: Preflight safe native Word fields
tools.description: Validate up to 200 typed Word fields without attaching to Word. Raw field codes are never accepted; formula fields use a restricted arithmetic grammar and external-data field classes are impossible to request.

tools.name: insert_live_word_fields
tools.title: Insert safe native fields directly in Microsoft Word
tools.description: Insert up to 200 typed native Word fields through one COM attachment, one surrounding-text payload and one Undo transaction. Supports page/document metadata, date/time, sequence, internal reference and restricted formula fields; raw or external-data field codes are rejected.

tools.name: insert_live_word_equation
tools.title: Insert native equation directly in open Microsoft Word
tools.description: Convert a LaTeX, UnicodeMath, Presentation MathML, or OMML string to Word linear math, create exactly one native editable OMath in the real open document, build it up, and show the change immediately.

tools.name: insert_live_word_equations_batch
tools.title: Insert a batch of native equations directly in open Microsoft Word
tools.description: Insert up to 100 LaTeX, UnicodeMath, Presentation MathML, or OMML equations as native editable Word OMath objects in one COM attachment and one Undo record. Use this for fast worksheets or step-by-step solutions.

tools.name: preflight_live_word_equations
tools.title: Preflight equations for Microsoft Word
tools.description: Securely parse and convert up to 200 LaTeX, UnicodeMath, Presentation MathML, or OMML equation strings before any Word mutation. DTDs and external XML resolution are prohibited. Returns the exact Word linear math that will be inserted.

tools.name: apply_live_word_operations
tools.title: Apply a fast mixed batch directly in open Microsoft Word
tools.description: Append up to 200 interleaved text and LaTeX, UnicodeMath, Presentation MathML, or OMML equation operations in one COM attachment and one Word Undo transaction. The complete batch is converted before mutation, inserted as one payload, and rolled back if styling, OMath build-up or native count verification fails.

tools.name: validate_live_word_document
tools.title: Validate open Word document snapshot
tools.description: Copy the already-saved live DOCX to an internal temporary snapshot, validate its OOXML and native equations, then discard the snapshot. Unsaved live changes are rejected so validation never saves implicitly.

tools.name: save_live_word_document
tools.title: Save the same open Microsoft Word document
tools.description: Call Document.Save on the connected Word Live document, writing changes to its existing path without exporting a new file. Unsaved, protected, or read-only documents are rejected.

tools.name: start_word_application
tools.title: Start or attach to Microsoft Word
tools.description: Start Microsoft Word through native COM when no automation-visible instance exists, or attach to the running instance. No shell, Python helper, or document is created.

tools.name: open_live_word_document
tools.title: Open an existing file in real Microsoft Word
tools.description: Open one explicit absolute local Word-readable DOC, DOCX, DOCM, DOT, DOTX, DOTM, ODT, RTF, TXT, PDF, HTML/MHTML, or XML path and return a connected versioned handle. Macros are force-disabled and external links are not updated during open. An already-open exact path is reused.

tools.name: insert_live_word_image
tools.title: Insert a native inline image
tools.description: Insert one explicit local image as a native embedded Word InlineShape at a token-verified selection/cursor or at the document end. Supports bounded dimensions and accessibility text in one guarded Undo transaction.

tools.name: insert_live_word_comment
tools.title: Comment an exact live Word selection or found range
tools.description: Add one native Word comment to exactly one fresh non-empty selection_token or content-bound range_token returned by find_live_word_text. The comment is created in one custom Undo record and verified by the native Comments collection.

tools.name: insert_live_word_note
tools.title: Insert a native footnote or endnote
tools.description: Insert one native Word footnote or endnote at a token-verified cursor/selection endpoint or the document end. Supports an optional bounded custom reference mark and one guarded Undo transaction.

tools.name: set_live_word_header_footer
tools.title: Set or clear a native header or footer
tools.description: Set or clear the primary, first-page, or even-page header/footer in one explicit section. Controls LinkToPrevious, enables the required page-layout variant, and applies bounded style/formatting in one Undo transaction.

tools.name: export_live_word_pdf
tools.title: Export the current live Word document to PDF
tools.description: Export the current live Word state, including unsaved edits, to a new PDF through Word ExportAsFixedFormat. The PDF is first written to a sibling temporary path and moved or atomically replaced only after a non-empty export is verified.

tools.name: close_live_word_document
tools.title: Close the connected Word document
tools.description: Close exactly one connected live document after an explicit save or discard choice. Saving an untitled document requires a new absolute DOCX output path; existing files are never overwritten.

tools.name: quit_word_application
tools.title: Quit the real Microsoft Word application
tools.description: Quit the attached Word application only after confirm=true and an explicit save_all or discard_all choice. save_all fails closed when any dirty document has no path instead of showing an automation-blocking Save As dialog.

tools.name: disconnect_live_word_document
tools.title: Disconnect Word Live document
tools.description: Release the WordToolkit live handle without closing Microsoft Word or the document.
